result.brief: 提出因果扩散框架 CIDER，利用当前与历史低分辨率帧及 G-buffer 引导实现游戏极端超分，并设计轻量潜空间投影编码器与微调 TAE 解码器以提升效率。
result.reason: Causal video diffusion for extreme game super-resolution with lightweight latent projection encoder and fine-tuned TAE decoder; contributes to video generation efficiency and latent representation design.
